question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Obedient
solution:
The correct answer is “**Disobedient**”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• '**Obedient**' means someone who complies or yield to commands or authority. (आज्ञाकारी)

 
 
• **Example**- Soldiers must be obedient and listen to their superiors.
 
 
 
• '**Disobedient**' means not obedient; refusing or neglecting to obey. (अवज्ञाकारी)
 
 
• **Example**- His disobedient behavior got him suspended from school.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is opposite in meaning to the given word is 'Disobedient'.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• '**Docile**' means easily managed or handled. (विनीत)
 
• '**Disciplined**' means obeying rules. (अनुशासित)
 
• '**Meekness**' means the quality of being patient, gentle. (नम्रता)
